$comment: Network/fetch ownership policy. Add entries only for committed security-reviewed egress owners.

anonymousPublicFetchOwners.justification: The capture-session owner performs anonymous public HTTPS asset fetches after URL and session authorization.
anonymousPublicFetchOwners.reviewNote: Every fetch must retain private-network rejection, session authority, credentials omit, pre-network redirect guard installation, redirect policy, and final-URL revalidation.

secretHeaderOwners.justification: The background LLM transport passes resolved model credentials to the canonical SDK provider runtime with the guarded network transport.
secretHeaderOwners.reviewNote: Keep SDK credential handoff in this owner. Require the guarded transport for destination checks, current admission, credentials omit, redirect refusal, bounded bodies, and deadlines. Keep secrets and secret-bearing headers outside UI, hooks, storage, and orchestration modules.

secretHeaderOwners.justification: The canonical audio transport handles project transcription and speech, plus explicitly configured private voice transcription.
secretHeaderOwners.reviewNote: Only this owner constructs audio bearer headers. Bind editor jobs to their admitted source scope. Bind voice jobs to immutable private history audio and the configured provider, destination and model code. Recheck authority after upload preparation. Require host permission, credentials omit, redirect error, bounded bodies and a deadline. Never retry paid requests, log provider responses or send binary IPC.

secretHeaderOwners.justification: The WebDAV adapter owns resolved provider authentication for one explicitly selected HTTPS root.
secretHeaderOwners.reviewNote: Resolve credentials in memory for each HTTP request. Require injected durable connection and origin-permission admission at actual fetch invocation, including the initial probe and DAV subrequests. Omit cookies, reject redirects and restrict requests to the selected root. Bound DAV metadata before parsing. Never log response bodies, addresses, filenames or raw errors. Track and drain issued requests outside the short admission lock.

secretHeaderOwners.justification: The optional provider fixture authenticates its synthetic collection and verifies ordinary originals independently from the extension transport.
secretHeaderOwners.reviewNote: Require an explicit loopback HTTP URL without embedded credentials, query or fragment. Restrict writes and cleanup to the randomly generated test child. Reject redirects. Read generated test credentials from the ignored secret file; never log credentials or authorization values. This fixture is outside product runtime and required CI.

secretHeaderOwners.justification: The background catalog transport constructs documented provider authentication headers for bounded metadata discovery.
secretHeaderOwners.reviewNote: Catalog calls require current provider admission, host permission, an already available secret, destination bounds, redirect refusal, a deadline, bounded pages and bytes. Never infer billing access from public catalogs or send user content.

credentialedFetchOwners.justification: The export download owner is the canonical content-runtime seam for same-origin credentialed file fetches after URL narrowing.
credentialedFetchOwners.reviewNote: Keep credentialed page-context downloads narrowed and contained here.

credentialedFetchOwners.justification: The Froala parser owner resolves same-origin filename metadata for export flows after URL narrowing.
credentialedFetchOwners.reviewNote: Credentialed Froala fetches must stay same-origin and remain confined to this parser seam.

credentialedFetchOwners.justification: Fetches same-origin DOM-discovered snapshot assets after URL safety and origin narrowing.
credentialedFetchOwners.reviewNote: Do not expand v1 web snapshots to cross-origin or response-body capture here.
